about.lead: I build the layer between model capability and dependable product behaviour.
body: My work sits at the intersection of generative AI and backend engineering. At Andro Buddy Technologies, I developed multi-agent workflows with LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI/xAI APIs for dynamic question generation, web research, and report generation — then built the PostgreSQL-backed state, REST APIs, authentication, caching, and storage around them.

I care about the unglamorous parts that decide whether an AI feature survives contact with users: structured outputs instead of brittle parsing, tracing instead of guesswork, policy checks before actions, and measured API performance. Hands-on project work with RAG, embeddings, ChromaDB, and MMR retrieval rounds out that production focus.

items.summary: Built AI workflows and the backend services around them, spanning agent orchestration, API performance, authentication, and cloud storage.
highlights: Developed multi-agent AI workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI/xAI APIs for dynamic question generation, web research, and report generation.
Integrated prompt templates, web-search tools, Pydantic structured outputs, and PostgreSQL-backed state management to support multi-step AI workflows.
Integrated Langfuse for LLM workflow tracing and monitoring.
Built and maintained REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and TypeScript.
Implemented Redis caching and rate limiting, achieving sub-50 ms response times on most tested APIs.
Worked on database indexing and query optimization.
Implemented authentication and authorization using JWT, JWE, and RBAC.
Integrated AWS S3 for application storage.

items.title: FleetOps AI
items.subtitle: Agentic Drone Incident Investigation Simulator
items.summary: A full-stack investigation platform that combines simulated drone telemetry, mission logs, and SOP retrieval to produce evidence-grounded diagnoses and response recommendations.
items.description: FleetOps AI treats an incident as a workflow with evidence requirements, not a single prompt. A LangGraph investigation path validates telemetry freshness, retrieves SOPs from ChromaDB, produces structured outputs, and falls back gracefully when model services fail. A deterministic Python policy gate sits between recommendation and simulated action, enforcing battery reserves, geofences, evidence, and role-based approval.
highlights: Built a full-stack agentic incident-investigation platform combining simulated drone telemetry, mission logs, and SOP retrieval to generate structured, evidence-grounded diagnoses and response recommendations.
Implemented a LangGraph investigation workflow with telemetry-freshness validation, ChromaDB retrieval, structured LLM outputs, and graceful fallback when model services fail.
Developed a deterministic Python safety-policy gate enforcing battery reserves, telemetry freshness, geofence constraints, evidence requirements, and role-based approval before simulated actions.
Implemented human-in-the-loop approvals, pre-execution policy revalidation, idempotent incident ingestion, and persistent audit trails using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.
Designed nine fault and safety scenarios covering duplicate events, missing or conflicting SOPs, tool timeouts, unauthorized approvals, and geofence violations.

items.title: Starts Club
items.subtitle: AI-Powered Startup Validation Platform
items.summary: The backend for an AI-powered startup validation platform, where a multi-agent workflow generates questions, researches the market, and produces a structured business report.
items.description: Starts Club coordinates several agents instead of asking one model to do everything. The workflow uses LangChain and LangGraph with OpenAI and xAI APIs, web-search tools, prompt templates, Pydantic structured outputs, and PostgreSQL-backed state. Langfuse provides tracing across the multi-step run. I worked with frontend and product teams to fold the workflow into the live platform.
highlights: Built the backend for an AI-powered startup validation platform using FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
Developed a multi-agent workflow for dynamic question generation, web research, and business report generation.
Implemented agent workflows using LangChain and LangGraph with OpenAI/xAI APIs, web-search tools, Pydantic structured outputs, prompt templates, and PostgreSQL-backed state management.
Integrated Langfuse for LLM workflow tracing and monitoring.
Collaborated with frontend and product teams to integrate the AI workflow into the platform.
